final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3, AVG(o.amount) as group_avg FROM `order` o INNER JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.amount >= 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg FROM group_avgs) SELECT g.account_id, g.A3, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg as difference FROM group_avgs g CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
